patch_description: This replaces local polynomial regression with a robust causal adaptive Kalman tracker. The filter estimates signal level and velocity as a state-space model, dynamically adjusts process noise according to innovation magnitude, and uses Huber-style innovation clipping to reject spikes. A two-sample directional confirmation gate prevents isolated countertrend measurements from creating false reversals, while strong innovations can still immediately trigger a genuine turn. Local MAD estimates from trailing first differences make the measurement uncertainty adapt to non-stationary volatility.
